# PRD-AI-03

**Have the agent's limits, approval gates and kill switch been shown to work, without the agent's cooperation?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | AI: Model and agent readiness |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Applies when | profiles include ai-agent |
| Reads | `elements.agent.limits`, `elements.agent.guardrails`, `evidence.type`, `evidence.covers` |

## Why it matters

A kill switch nobody has pulled is a hope. The agent lens asks whether the controls are designed; production asks whether they work.

## Rule

For every element with an agent facet, evidence has a control-test for this version, with outcome passed, whose covers includes the element.
